description: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between the “Number of Shots” (ranging from 0 to 4, shown on the horizontal axis) and a performance metric labeled “γB” (on the vertical axis, scaled from 0.0 to 0.6 in increments of 0.2). For each shot count, two bars are displayed: a blue dotted bar and a magenta diagonally striped bar labeled “Correct” in the legend. The blue dotted bars, representing a baseline or alternative condition, decrease in height from approximately 0.41 at 0 shots to about 0.29 at 4 shots. In contrast, the magenta “Correct” bars remain consistently high across all shot counts, starting at approximately 0.68 at 0 shots and gradually declining to about 0.46 at 4 shots, indicating sustained high performance relative to the blue bars. The chart visually emphasizes that the “Correct” condition consistently outperforms the dotted condition across all shot levels, with the performance gap narrowing slightly as the number of shots increases. The legend at the top includes a gray placeholder bar with no label, which does not correspond to any visible data in the chart.
